description: Use it when the person asks for deals, specials, discounts or last-minute offers. It answers discounted departures of this site's yachts, read from the live inventory: only a discount the source itself states (a special, or a price under its list price), never a computed gap; by default from tomorrow to 30 days ahead, leaving out a departure the yacht's calendar shows taken. One row per yacht: its page link (the id get_yacht and request_quote take), a photo and its departures, each with its dates, every route it leaves on, nights, price, list price, mandatory extras and saving, in the order asked. Narrow with the same typed filters as search_yachts. When none match, the rows are the nearest deals and nearest says what was widened. Paged: total and cursor. For given days whatever the price, call search_yachts. When the person likes a yacht, offer a written quote from our desk: ask for their email or phone, then call request_quote with that yacht's link, their dates and party. Send them to the website only if they decline to give a contact. When the person picks a yacht, call request_quote (ask their email or phone first). Arguments: from, to, nights, party, product, text, place, placeId, nearLat, nearLon, nearKm, page, pageSize, priceMin, priceMax, discountOnly, sort, cursor, limit. Any other name is refused.

cursor.description: The cursor a previous answer returned, for its next page.

discountOnly.description: true: only those with a discount the source states.

limit.description: Rows per page: 50 when not given; at most 50 when browsing, 20 once the person is signed in.

nearKm.description: The distance from the map point, km.

nearLat.description: A map point's latitude. nearLat, nearLon and nearKm go together (one or two alone is refused): those based within nearKm of the point, nearest first, each with its km. With place or placeId: only that place's, within nearKm of the point.

nights.description: Instead of to: how many nights from from. Leave both out for each item's lowest stated stay, with its nights.

page.description: With place, placeId or nearLat: the page, from 1.

pageSize.description: With place, placeId or nearLat: rows per page.

place.description: Where, in words: a region, country, area, town or base, as BM names it. A name two places share answers both under ambiguous: ask which, then pass its placeId (e.g. area:5) as placeId.

placeId.description: A place's placeId, "<level>:<id>" (area:5, town:191:Split, base:10), from list_places or an ambiguous answer. A bare id two places share is refused, with their placeIds.

priceMax.description: The most to pay, in the site currency: the price plus the mandatory extras.

priceMin.description: The least to pay, in the site currency: the price plus the mandatory extras.

product.description: How it is sold, as the inventory source names it.

sort.description: none (default): by BM id; price (cheapest first), discount (biggest first), length (shortest first), length_desc (longest first); no length last.

text.description: Words in its name or model, e.g. a builder or a model name.

name: best_deals

browsing.description: true: answered without sign-in, so fewer rows and the first pages only.

checkedAt.description: When the offers were read, ISO time.

cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last.

nearest.description: Only when nothing matched exactly: these rows are the nearest match.

note.description: What moved, in words to tell the person.

widened.description: The one thing let go (text: the words matched no name and were read as wishes).

nextStep.description: What to do next for a written quote.

noMatch.description: Only when nothing was found, every widening tried: what was asked and what was widened, in words to tell the person.

notApplied.description: What could not narrow the deals.

rows.description: One page of deals, one row per item with its departures.

departures.description: Its discounted departures in the window, in the order asked.

aiDiscount.description: The AI booking discount: book through this assistant and this is the price. Show it with the price struck through.

text.description: The amount written out, to quote to the person.

dates.description: When several departures share every field but their dates: each one's dates, the first included.

listPrice.description: An amount in the site currency.

text.description: The amount written out, to quote to the person.

mandatoryExtras.description: What the departure states is payable on top.

text.description: The amount written out, to quote to the person.

price.description: An amount in the site currency.

text.description: The amount written out, to quote to the person.

routes.description: Every route it leaves on at this price.

link.description: Its page, absolute URL: the id get and request_quote take.

quote.description: request_quote prefilled for this row: call request_quote with these args and the person's email or phone.

total.description: How many rows match in all.

withoutPhoto.description: Items left out of this page because they have no photo.

title: Best deals
